violation_type.title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))
violation_type.short_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age
violation_type.typical_finding: There was a torn mat used by a child during naptime.

finding_variants.text: There was a torn mat used by a child during naptime.
There were two mats being used to sleep on in the PreK classroom that had rips on them.    This was corrected when the caregiver change mats to new mats.
Several mats observed in the classrooms were torn and the foam was exposed.    Corrected at inspection: The torn mats were removed from the classrooms.

A child was observed partially sleeping on the bare floor during nap time due to their personal blanket being too small to wrap the child.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director provided a mat for the child.
There are 5 mats torn with the foam filling exposed.  This was corrected at inspection when the mats were replaced with the new ones.
Two of the children's nap mats were torn and the foam inside was exposed, so the mats were no longer waterproof.
